Cognitive Processing Speed.name: Speed
Cognitive Processing Speed.description: the efficiency and speed at which an individual can perform mental tasks. It influences the number of errors made in tasks that require quick identification and marking of figures, letters, and numbers, as slower processing speed may lead to increased errors across these tasks

Cognitive Ability.name: Cognitive Ability
Cognitive Ability.description: the mental capacity to reason, plan, solve problems, think abstractly, comprehend complex ideas, learn quickly, and learn from experience. It influences performance across various tasks, including answering questions correctly in different parts of an experiment
